record.field: Folios whose stay is finished (every reservation checked out) with a checkout date in a period (at most 93 days) that still have an amount to invoice, by property: number of folios and untaxed amount, how many lack customer data, have pending payments or are already partly invoiced, and the largest ones with their reason hints. Folios with reservations not checked out are reported apart. Read only; no guest data.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Overdue customer invoices (posted, with an open amount and a due date before the reference date) in aging buckets of 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days, by property, plus the 20 largest debtors; it can be limited to agencies or to companies. Read only; needs accounting access.

Cash differences recorded when closing (or opening) the cash sessions of the hotels in a period (at most 93 days): property, cash journal, date, amount (negative: cash missing; positive: surplus) and the user who recorded it. Cash sessions are the statements of the cash journals and a difference is the line posted to the journal's loss or profit account. Read only.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Lines of an invoice or credit note given its number or id: description, untaxed amount, tax and total of each line; the invoice a credit note reverses and the credit notes of an invoice; and the payments, bank statement lines, down payments or credit notes applied to it with their dates. Read only; needs accounting access.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Vendor bills pending payment at a cutoff date: posted bills with an accounting date up to the cutoff and the amount still pending on that date according to the dates of the payments (partial payments count by their own date), by company, property and supplier, with the bill list (due date, total, paid and pending at the cutoff) and a summary of the bills still in draft. Read only; needs accounting access.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Posted vendor bills of the user's properties in a period (at most 93 days), filtered by account code prefixes (601, 62...), supplier, amount or text; the posted lines (account, label, untaxed, tax) grouped by supplier, account, month or property; and a payment analysis (real method and journal, payment dates, split payments, paid and pending, days from bill date to payment and delay against the due date, weighted average real days and share paid late) grouped by supplier, property, method, account or month. Bills reconciled directly with a bank statement line are flagged: only the journal type is known. Read only; needs accounting access.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Differences above a threshold (default 0.05) between the total of a purchase order and the total of its posted vendor bills, for the bills of a period (at most 93 days): company, property, supplier, bills, order and bills totals and the difference, plus a summary of the vendor bills pending validation (draft) or payment by company. Needs the purchase module; read only; needs accounting access.

Audit of the point of sale (for example a hotel cafeteria) sessions opened in a period (at most 93 days): open and closed sessions with opening and closing balance, closing differences per session and employee, sales, refunds and cancelled orders, payments by method (cash, card terminal), card payments booked and not yet reconciled with the bank, closed sessions without a posted accounting entry and the balance of the cash journals. Needs the point of sale module; read only; needs accounting access.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Create the invoice of a folio, given its code or id, exactly as its Create invoice button does: the folio's own invoicing chooses the journal (simplified invoice for the anonymous customer, full invoice otherwise), the taxes and the down payment deductions. Options: only some sale lines (at most 50), another customer to invoice, and post the invoices or leave them in draft (default). The preview lists the invoices, their lines and amounts, the customer and the type of invoice, and warns about missing customer data. Needs accounting access. Two steps: confirm=false previews; only after the user's approval, confirm=true with the token.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Move a payment registered on the wrong folio to the right one, given both folio codes or ids (and the payment id when the first folio has several payments). It changes the folio of the payment as its form does, so the accounting entry and the pending amounts of both folios follow. Only posted customer payments of a single folio that are not reconciled can be moved. The preview shows the payment and the pending amount of both folios before and after. Needs accounting access. Two steps: confirm=false previews; only after the user's approval, confirm=true with the token.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Administration worklist of the day for the user's companies and properties, optionally one company or some properties: draft vendor bills (count, age of the oldest, the oldest ones), vendor bills flagged to check or drafts missing partner, bill date, account or taxes, probable duplicate vendor bills (same supplier and reference, or same supplier, total and bill date), vendor bills overdue and due in the next 7 days with the pending amounts, overdue customer invoices, posted payments and collections not applied yet and, if the module is installed, draft payment orders. Each section gives counts, at most 10 items and the tools to act on it next. Read only; needs accounting access.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Small corrections on up to 20 records of one model, with the old and new value of each field in the preview. Closed list: draft invoices and bills (account.move: partner_id, ref, payment_reference, invoice_date, date, invoice_date_due, partner_bank_id, narration, to_check, payment_mode_id), draft payments (account.payment: date, ref, partner_id, partner_bank_id), partners (res.partner: name, vat, email, phone, mobile, street, street2, zip, city, state_id, country_id, property_payment_term_id, property_supplier_payment_term_id) and bank accounts (res.partner.bank: acc_number, bank_id). fields and values are parallel lists; values are text: dates YYYY-MM-DD, true or false, a related record by id or exact name. Refuses other models or fields, posted records and records outside the user's companies and properties; never creates or deletes. Changes data as the user: needs an explicit list of allowed users. Two steps: confirm=false previews; only after the user's approval, confirm=true with the token.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Edit ONE draft vendor bill or vendor credit note of the user's companies and properties, given by id or by its number or supplier reference. Header: partner (id or VAT), supplier reference, payment reference, invoice date, accounting date, due date (not when a payment term computes it), bank account (one of the partner's), payment mode and the "to check" flag. Lines: give up to 20 line ids plus the change for all of them: account code, purchase taxes (replace the current ones) or label; quantity and unit price only for a single line. Changing the partner also brings its payment term, payment mode and bank account, as Odoo does. The preview shows old and new values and the new totals; the change is saved with the user's rights and aborted if the result differs from the preview. Posted bills are refused. Two steps: confirm=false previews; only after the user's approval, confirm=true with the token.

SENSITIVE (accounting data). Post (validate) up to 50 draft vendor bills or vendor credit notes of the user's companies and properties, given by ids, by numbers or supplier references, or by properties and an accounting date range (at most 93 days). The preview lists the bills ready to post and the others with their reasons: missing partner or invoice date, lines without account or taxes, total not positive, flagged to check, or a probable duplicate (a posted bill of the same supplier with the same supplier reference, or the same total and invoice date). Only the ready bills are posted, one by one with the user's rights; the result lists the posted bills and those that failed with the error. Two steps: confirm=false previews; only after the user's approval, confirm=true with the token.
